business_summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. designs Meta Training and Inference Accelerator (MTIA) chips for internal AI workloads, builds and operates hyperscale data-center campuses for AI and consumer services, researches and serves the Llama family of foundation models, and ships the Meta AI assistant across its own apps. It sits on four links: ai-accelerators, hyperscale-datacenters, frontier-models and ai-applications, funded by its advertising business, which this chain does not cover.

exposure_summary.narrative: Each of the four placements is backed by a dated source, including Meta's own Llama 4 and Meta AI app announcements. All four sit inside a company whose revenue is overwhelmingly advertising; the AI-infrastructure roles here are capital expenditure and product investments funded by that business rather than independent revenue lines.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/META.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 1487823480000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 200966000000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/META.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 1487823480000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 60458000000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/META.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 1556025480000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 200966000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1556025480000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 46109000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.2119, '7': 0.1618, '10': 0.1257}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.
